fact: The 2019 diagnostic in the PE-SEN 2020-2024 states the SEN is still governed by Law 7/96, over 23 years old, whose revision begun in 2008-2012 was not completed, and plans its revision and submission to parliament in 2020.
title: Plano Estratégico do Sistema Estatístico Nacional 2020-2024
